**Finding: Compliant** (RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

The renewal terms are in Section 13 "TERM OF AGREEMENT" (p0078), which is mis-nested under the Section 12 heading in the document structure — hence the planner's expectation that it was absent.

**Material terms both meet the preferred position:**
- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods — no multi-year auto-renewal (walk-away trigger avoided).
- **Non-renewal notice:** **30 days** prior to end of term, exercisable by either party, so we can exit unilaterally. This satisfies preferred (≤30 days), not merely the ≤60-day fallback.

Section 14 (p0079) reinforces our exit: on written notice, service runs only to the last day of the following month.

**Noted, not flagged:**
- No Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal.
- No renewal price-uplift cap — Section 6 (p0047) only freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds a most-favoured-rate covenant, with no CPI/3% or 5% ceiling thereafter.

Both are sub-elements the playbook expressly treats as rationale notes rather than deviations, so no redline was proposed. Worth raising if the agreement is reopened for other reasons.
